title: An asset with no year, make or model is labeled with the VIN on its own
custom_preconds: 1. A ZZAUTOTEST asset exists with a VIN but no year, make, or model, and has an invoice in range.
custom_steps: 1. Expand the owning customer and read that asset row's label.
custom_expected: 1. The label is the VIN on its own (no year/make/model base, no "VIN …" suffix form).
